caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a small round opening at the top. The jug has a thick curved handle extending from the neck to the upper shoulder. The body of the jug is colored in earthy, tan-brown hues with subtle variations in shading to indicate its curved surface. There is a blue decoration on the upper part of the jug, consisting of a simple floral or abstract design. Near the base of the jug, there is a square or rectangular protrusion with a circular hole in the center, suggesting a spout or tap opening, likely used for dispensing liquid. The background is a solid, light beige color with no other objects or details present in the composition. A signature, "John Jarquinto," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
